map.layout: A short stair down from a side passage ends at a landing with alcoves on both sides and a floor that is not a floor.
map.cover: Alcove frames and clipboard stands (half cover).

voice_lines.intro: EXIT. A marked stairwell sign is ahead, with a countdown. Audio: birds. There are no birds on this floor.
voice_lines.twist: The floor drops out, the clipboards come out, and a very polite goblin in a green vest asks if you have an appointment.
voice_lines.win: The greeters are down and the back office is open: a workshop full of unapproved inventory. Management is furious and also taking notes.
